messages.content: amar ekjon fan ache je onek beshi personal question kore, uncomfortable lage
real location, real name, emon shob jigges kore repeatedly
Eta clearly boundary cross kora, ignore kore chalanor dorkar nai. Ekbar clearly bole dao je personal info share korba na, tarpor continue korle mute ba block kore dao - eta tomar right.
block korle fan lose hobe, eta niye worry hocche
Ekjon fan lose howa ar nijer safety/comfort compromise kora - eta trade-off tomar favor e thaka uchit na. Ei rokom fan der jonno business build kora sustainable na, tara actually risk.
